nodes.label: Firestore Batch Write
nodes.rationale: Uses writeBatch for atomic all-or-nothing import; prevents partial data loss on failure

nodes.label: Upload Config Preview Result Wizard
nodes.rationale: Four-step wizard: upload CSV, configure batch context, preview validation, show result

nodes.label: Atomic Batch Operation
nodes.rationale: writeBatch ensures all-or-nothing import; no partial imports on failure

nodes.label: Curriculum Versioning
nodes.rationale: Separate versions by year and track to prevent historical grade records from being corrupted when curriculum changes

nodes.label: No Vertical Scroll Layout
nodes.rationale: h-[calc(100vh-200px)] with overflow-hidden locks page to single viewport without vertical scrollbar

nodes.label: One Student One Room Rule
nodes.rationale: A student may belong to only one classroom per academic year; validated before assignment

nodes.label: Grade Book Access Auto-Sync
nodes.rationale: Assigning a subject teacher auto-updates permissions so teacher can access grade book for that classroom

nodes.label: Enrollment Snapshot Strategy
nodes.rationale: Copy creditAtEnrollment from curriculum at enrollment time so GPAX of past cohorts is unaffected by later credit changes

nodes.label: Student Curriculum Binding Rule
nodes.rationale: Each student is bound to one curriculumId for their entire enrollment period

nodes.label: isRetired Soft Delete
nodes.rationale: Courses with enrolled students cannot be deleted; use isRetired true instead

nodes.label: Question Lock Immutability
nodes.rationale: isLocked true when question used in exam paper; prevents retroactive answer changes; duplicate instead of edit

nodes.label: Geofencing
nodes.rationale: Geolocation API validates check-in within 100-200m radius of school coordinates using Haversine formula

nodes.label: Server-Side Grading
nodes.rationale: Answers sent to Cloud Functions only; correct answers never sent to client; score written by server

nodes.label: Anti-Cheat Tab Switch Detection
nodes.rationale: visibilitychange and window.onblur increment suspiciousActivities counter for proctor alerting
